description: This file defines the InvalidProxyAddressException class which extends RuntimeException and implements ExceptionInterface. It provides static methods to generate exceptions for invalid proxy arguments and addresses, indicating errors related to proxy and IP address validation.

classes.name: InvalidProxyAddressException
classes.description: Custom exception class for invalid proxy address errors, with methods to generate specific error messages.

methods.name: forInvalidProxyArgument
methods.description: Generates an exception message for an invalid proxy argument, specifying its type.

methods.name: forAddress
methods.description: Generates an exception message when a provided proxy address is invalid.
